description: Checked-in support and release disclosure policy. Concrete run outputs and development history are stored outside the source repository. Historical execution applies only to the named source revision and recorded configuration.

Versioned managed API snapshots are reviewable source contracts; public API changes require explicit baseline review.
Full release qualification remains incomplete. Historical focused runs do not qualify the current source revision or all runtime paths.
Historical functional, isolation, timing and partial long-run sessions exist. Full promotion, including restart and resource-observation requirements, remains incomplete.
Thirteen matrix cases remain deferred. Host-reference custom-op diagnostics do not qualify GPU/device callbacks or complete provider lifetimes.
The fixed official MIGraphX baseline targets Linux. Managed Windows builds do not provide an official Windows native runtime.
